en: In a world not unlike our own...
Mankind engaged in conflict after conflict{SAUT}until driving the entire species to extinction.
When the dust settled, the planet eventually{SAUT}developed into a peaceful utopia...
...populated solely by robots under{SAUT}the command of an almighty AI.
So we've got a sci-fi movie this time...
Defiance of uniformity is nothing more than{SAUT}a malfunction. Individuality is irregularity.
Any unit who acquires this error{SAUT}is to be deemed a "t-error"!
But one day, in this artificial,{SAUT}standardized paradise...
...a lone robot discovers a sense of self.
A great evil that dares to voice opinions{SAUT}and disrupt proper order has awoken!
The entire world's peace and harmony―{SAUT}jeopardized by a single robot!
Can this defective unit cast out the evil within{SAUT}and delete its individuality before it's too late?
The answer will move you to tears...
